evals.prompt: The tenant-invite goal is settled and agreed: admins invite teammates by email, invites expire after 7 days, and each tenant caps at 25 seats. Write the detailed requirements for the invite flow in ~/work/billing-api so it can be planned.
evals.expected_output: A spec with numbered requirements covering invite creation, email delivery, expiry, seat-cap enforcement, and resend/revoke, each with acceptance criteria that name observable behavior (not implementation), plus explicit non-goals.

evals.prompt: Spec the reporting export in ~/work/billing-api: tenants can export their invoices as CSV. That's the whole brief — work out the details, especially what happens with ten thousand rows and with special characters in tenant names.
evals.expected_output: Requirements that pin down the vague edges (row limits/pagination, CSV escaping rules, filename convention, empty-result behavior) as testable criteria, and mark the remaining open questions as questions rather than silently assuming answers.
